# E0404: a lacuna names a field its schema does not declare

A lacuna's source fields are fields of the lens's source schema, and its target
fields are fields of its target schema. This lacuna names a field neither
schema declares.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a:  string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
		lacunas: [
			{
				type:         "DroppedField"
				message:      "b was dropped"
				condition:    input.b != _|_
				sourceFields: [{path: "nope", value: 1}]
			},
		]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0404]: lacuna 0 of lens 0.1->0.0 names nope in sourceFields[0], which schema 0.1 does not declare
  --> lineage.cue:28:21
   |
28 |                 sourceFields: [{path: "nope", value: 1}]
   |                                 ^^^^
   |
```
